nom: Uriage Eau Thermale Serum Booster With 1,5% Pure&Natural Hyaluronic Acid, 86% Plumped Skin, Peachy-Soft Skin Effect, Lovely Scent, Non-Comedogenic

avis.titre: Absorb Fast, Good Hydration.Absorb Fast, Good Hydration.
avis.texte: I use this URIAGE Thermal Water Booster Serum in the morning and I apply to my whole face. The bottle is blue color, but the serum inside is clear color. It has a light mint type of scent and the serum is slightly slippery when touching. My skin type is oily and combination, the serum absorbs very fast on my face. Right after applying, I can feel my skin is calm and deeply hydrated. It feels pretty nice on the spot. The fine lines under my eyes are filled up and becomes much less noticeable. I observed a few times across the whole day, the hydration seems will fade away probably 4-5 hours after application on my skin. Maybe the summer weather in California is really too dry for my skin. In order to keep my skin hydrated for a whole day, I will use this serum 2 times a day. Overall, I think this serum does provide a good hydration.
My Dr recomended this brand while I was in Colombia doing skin care. Best quality HA I have used. I layer it on top of Retinol on my face and morning face is better than ever.

avis.titre: My first bottle was gifted to me
avis.texte: And I’ve been wearing it ever since. This is my go to day serum. It immediately hydrates your face, leaving your face glowing.
One of the best products I’ve tried, I really like this brand and it’s pretty affordable for the quality.

avis.titre: Excellent hydration; perfect for skincare layering; moderate but pleasant fragrance
avis.texte: I really like this hydrating serum a lot. It's become a regular part of my skincare routine, and I use it whenever my skin needs an extra hydration boost. I expect I'll use it daily during the cold months. It has a moderate level of fragrance that lingers after application. I don't mind because it's an ocean-type scent that I like. The serum is thin to medium thickness, and I use about 4 drops to generously cover my face. It absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness. It sits very nicely on my skin, so I use it after my toner, but before any other serums or moisturizer. It's currently priced at $28, which I would normally say is high for a Hyaluronic Acid serum, but since this one is so effective and pleasant to use, I think it's fairly priced.

This is a review for: URIAGE Thermal Water Booster Serum | 1.5% Pure Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum. Anti-Aging Serum for Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Hydrating Serum to Plump and Repair Dry Skin, Safe on Sensitive Skin This is a clear, slightly runny serum with a lovely fruity scent. It reminds me of a mix of green grape and Korean plum candy, which I thought was really nice. The serum goes on nicely and absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling hydrated. I did not experience any redness, irritation or breakouts after using this product. Overall pretty happy with the serum.

This serum from URIAGE is wonderful. I love this serums scent and the bottle looks great. More importantly, the serum in the bottle works fantastically well to hydrate my skin. I use this right out of the shower and it leaves my skin feeling very hydrated and healthy. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone!

This review is for URIAGE Thermal Water Booster Serum 1 fl oz. It is Paraben and Phthalate free and is hypoallergenic. This serum uses Hyaluronic Acid, Aquaxyl, and Thermal Water to help with moisturization and protect skin. It's to be applied before moisturizing to help boost skin's hydration.

avis.titre: Good hydrating ingredients but contains parfum
avis.texte: This Uriage Serum Booster has a watery scent which I think it is too strong for this type of product and lingers too long. I prefer facial products without added fragrance, and this has parfum listed as an ingredient. It's not usually a dealbreaker for me, but I wouldn't get this one because I don't like the smell and worry that the strength will make it irritating. Otherwise, this has a lot of great hydrating ingredients. It feels a little sticky going on, but it absorbs quickly. It's meant to be used with the brand's Water Cream, but unfortunately I didn't get a chance to try them together. I used another brand of moisturizer. I did notice it hydrated and softened my skin.
Great ingredients for a extra boost of hydration. Perfect for layering under skincare or mixing it into a moisturizer. Packaging is nice heavy glass.
